fact: Prime Minister Dbaiba of the Government of National Unity launched the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2026-2030 on 1 June 2026, per LANA citing his media office.

The General Information Authority made the full National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence in the State of Libya 2025-2030 public on its website, calling it the highest reference strategy of the Libyan state (document gives no separate date; published date used).
system: National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence in the State of Libya 2025-2030

fact: The General Information Authority hosted a meeting on 26 April 2026 on moving Libya's National AI Strategy 2025-2030 from preparation to implementation, under the Minister of State for Digital Economy and AI (published 3 May 2026).
A workshop on 28 April 2026, attended by the Minister of State for Digital Economy and AI, was devoted to following implementation of the National AI Strategy 2025-2030, per LANA.
SMEX says the Government of National Unity unveiled the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2026-2030 on 1 June 2026 in Tripoli.
